product: New jobs compute defaults to Auto access mode
tagline: When you create new jobs compute in the UI, the access mode now defaults to Auto instead of Dedicated.
what_it_does: When you create new jobs compute in the UI, the access mode now defaults to Auto instead of Dedicated. Auto uses Standard access mode unless a machine learning runtime, a GPU instance type, or a Databricks Runtime version lower than 14.3 is selected. A cluster policy that enforces a different access mode still takes precedence.
why_it_matters: For workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled, this change takes effect in December 2026.
